WITH pay AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(paid_amount) AS total_paid,
        MAX(paid_date) AS last_dt
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'payments') }}
    GROUP BY order_id
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.amount,
        CASE
            WHEN p.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(p.total_paid AS DECIMAL(18,2))
            ELSE CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        END AS paid,
        CAST(p.last_dt AS DATE) AS last_paid
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
    LEFT JOIN pay p
        ON p.order_id = o.order_id
)
SELECT
    order_id,
    amount,
    paid,
    amount - paid AS outstanding,
    last_paid
FROM base

explanation: This procedure builds an outstanding-balance report with one row per order. Every order starts with zero paid and no last payment date, then each order that has payments is updated with the total paid and the most recent payment date. The output shows the order amount, the amount paid, the amount still outstanding (amount minus paid), and the last payment date. Orders with no payments show zero paid and a blank last payment date.
